name: JAMES_SON_OF_ALPHAEUS
canonical: James the son of Alphaeus, called 'James the less', the youngest and smallest of the Twelve, a slight short-statured youth of about the early twenties with smooth fair-olive skin and a boyish earnest unlined face, sparse soft beginnings of a light-brown beard barely shadowing his jaw, short curly light-brown hair, dressed in a simple undyed homespun tunic and a plain pale-tan mantle a touch too large for his small frame, a quiet modest gaze
